description: This file defines the CustomerEntity class, which extends the Customer class and implements Serializable. It includes fields related to customer details such as email, address, gender, name, password, and store code, along with their getters and setters. It uses validation annotations to enforce constraints on email and username fields.

classes.name: CustomerEntity
classes.description: A Java class representing a customer entity with fields for personal information, addresses, credentials, and store information, extending Customer and implementing Serializable.

methods.name: setUserName
methods.description: Sets the username of the customer.

methods.name: getUserName
methods.description: Returns the username of the customer.

methods.name: setStoreCode
methods.description: Sets the store code associated with the customer.

methods.name: setEmailAddress
methods.description: Sets the email address of the customer.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the preferred language of the customer.
